name: migaki-openai-agents-js
description: Migaki instrumentation for the OpenAI Agents SDK for JavaScript.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path='dist/benchmark.js'; fs.writeFileSync(path, fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').replaceAll('from \"@migaki/runtime\"','from \"../../runtime/dist/observed-trajectory-comparison.js\"'));"
